content: Gayaburba anmaryobi sanale nonikid
Bab-Dummad, dule-wargwen barmiargusad. We-dule, Juanʼye nugad.
We-dule, gwallu-meegwad-barsogega nonikid, adi, bela dulemar a-gwallu-meegwad mer bengumalagar.
We-dule-Juanʼye-nugadi, gwallu-meegwadsulid. We-dule, unnila gwallu-meegwad-barsogegala nonikid.
We-gwallu-meegwad we-napnegse-danikidi, napiragwadid. We-gwallu-meegwad bela dulemarga neg-mee imaked.
We-gwallu-meegwad we-napneggi gudigusad. Ar we-napneg a-sogedba nagus-inigwele, degite, dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmalad akudaksamalad.
We-gwallu-meegwad e-dulemarse nonikinad, e-dulemar gwen abingassurmalad.
Ar bela dulemar we-Gayaburba-abingasmaladdi, e-nuggi-bengussurmaladba, amarga Bab-Dummad-e-mimmiganga-guega igar-uknonikid.

We-dulemala, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledba gwalulenonimalad. Dulemar-sogedba gwalulessurmalad, dulemar-igarginsulid, dulemar-binsaedginsurbalid. Wemar Bab-Dummad-sogedba Bab-Burba-Isligwaledgi gwalulenonimalad.

We-Gayaburba, anmaryobi sanale san-nika gunonimogad, degine, anmar-abargi sanale gudigusmogad. Anmar e-gangued-yeerdakleged daksamalad. Unnila Bab-Machi-Wargwenna-Gued-e-gangued-yeerdakleged anmar daksamalad. We-dule, nue-dulemar-sabe nanadii gusad. Degine, igar-napiragwadgi nanadii gusbalid.

Diigi-dule-oged-Juan a-dulegi sunmaksagusad, sogdegusad, deun binnasur gotegusgu: “An a-dulegi bemarga sunmaksa gusmalad: ‘Dule-wargwen an-sorba-danikoedi, a, an-iduedid, ar a-inse an-idu gudiguad.’ ”
Ar a-dule, bela-bela anmargi nued binsamaisoggu, belagwapa ibmar-nikadba ibmar-nuegan anmarga ukmaiguad.
Ar Bab-Dummad Moisésʼba dulemarga igar mesisad, dulemar igi nanaergebe. Ar Bab-Dummad na e-nue-sabeddi, degi, e-igar-napiragwaddi, Jesucristoʼba anmarga uknonikid.
Dule gwen Bab-Dummad dakdisulid. Unnila Bab-Dummad-Machi-Wargwennagwad, e-Babba-mesa-gudiid, a, anmarga Bab-Dummad-osanalononikid.
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan ede Cristoʼsurye sogsad

Diigi-dule-oged-Juan weyobi Jesúsʼgi sunmaksagusgu, weyob gusdo. Deunni, Judíoʼmar-dummagan Jerusalén-akar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad, degi, a-bendakmalad-Levitaʼmar barmiargusad, Juanʼse-egismalaga: —¿Be doa-dulesunna?
Juan gwen yapa-soge gussulid. Innikigwadba sogsad: —Ani an Cristoʼsulid.

Degi, gannar Juanʼse egichidmarbalid: —Degite, ¿be doa-dulesunna? ¿Be Elías? Juan, abin-imaksad: —Suli, an a-dulesurbali. Juanʼga sogdemarbarsunnad: —Degite, ¿be Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged anmar edarbediiddi? Juan, abin-imakdebalid: —Suli, an a-dulesuli.
Degi ega sogdemarsunnad: —Degite, ¿be doa-dulesunna? Ar anmar dule-anmar-barmialidga sogergebed, be doa-dule. Degite, ¿doa-duleye na be sogsunna?
Juan, abin-sogdegusad: —Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías sogsa gusad:
Isaías 40:3
Dulemar-Juanʼse-barmilear-gusadi, Fariseo-sapingan gumalad.

Amar Juanʼse egichiarmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Ar bede Cristo-sulidde, degi, Elías-surbalidde, degine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-anmar-edarbediid-surbalidde. Ar degite, ¿ibiga be Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imakdisunna?
Juan, amar-abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Andi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakedi, unnila diigi dule-ogdiid. Ar bemar-abargi dule-wargwen-gudiiddi aku be dakmalad.
A-dule an-sorba-danikidi, we an-iduedid. Ar anba bur dule-dummadsoggu, e-sapat-dubse-bakar geg an ei esiked.
We-degigusadi, Betania-neg-nugadgi, Jordán-diwar-obakar, bia Juan Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaknai, agi deyob gusdo.
Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Sibad-Wawaad-E-Mimmid
A-banedgine, Juan, Jesús-ese-dani-dakargua, sogded: “Be dakmalana, we-dule, Bab-Dummad-Sibad-Wawaad-E-Mimmid, bela dulemarga we-napneggi isgued-osulogedid.
We-dulenik an sogsagusad: ‘Dule-wargwen an-sorba danikid, a-dule an-iduedid, ar ade, a-inse an-idu gudiguad.’
Aku a-dule an dakmoganad. A-ulale, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar an imaknonikid. Adi, Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-epenne-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule magar dakmalagar.”
Juan, Jesúsʼnik sogsagusbalid: “Nibneg-akar Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nuuyobi aidedani, an daksad. Degi, a-dulegi signoni an daksad.

An a-dule akudakmoganad. Ar Bab-Dummad E-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakega-an-barmialidi, anga sogsad: ‘Dule-wargwengi Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nuuyob-aidedani, degi, egi signoni, be daksale, we-dule, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi dulemar-ogoed-duledo.’
We deyob an daksad. Degisoggu, an sogdo, we-dule, nue-Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadye.”
Gebe Jesúsʼba-nagusmalad
A-banedgine, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan, degine, e-sapingan-warbogwadmala iduar-gudigusadgi gannar gudiid.
Deunni dakalid, Jesús e-walik gudii. Geb Juan sogded: —Be dakmalana, we-dule, Bab-Dummad-Sibad-Wawaad-E-Mimmid.
Juan-e-sapingan-warbogwad degi-soge-itosgu, Jesúsʼba nadegusmalad.
Jesús sorba-atakdegu, dule-warbogwad eba-dani-dakargu, amarga sogded: —¿Ibu be amimala? Amar, abin-sogdemalad: —Rabí, ¿bia be mai? (Rabí sogleged, odurdaked-sailaye).
Jesús amarga sogded: —Be dagmar. Degi, be dakmaloed bia an mai. Amar Jesúsʼba nadegusmalad, degi, daksamalad bia Jesús mai. A-ibagi Jesús-walik osedosmalad, ar ade, bato sedosad.
Dule-warbogwad Juan-sunmak-itosgu Jesúsʼba nadegusmaladi, wargwenadi Andrésʼye-nugad, Simón-Pedro-e-urbad.
Andrésʼde, e-ia-Simón-inse aminaded. Simón-amisgu, ega sogded: —Anmar Mesías-amisad. (Mesías sogleged, Cristoʼye).
Geb degi, Andrés, Jesúsʼse e-ia-Simón-senonikid. Jesús, Simón-nuu-dakdegu, ega sogded: —Be, Simón Jonás-machi, emigindi, Cefasʼye be nugguoed. (A sogleged, Pedroʼye).
Jesús, Felipeʼse, degi, Natanaelʼse gochad
A-banedgine, Jesús Galileaʼse naesokargu, Felipe-dakalid, ega sogded: —Anba be dage.
Felipe, Betsaida-neggweburginedid. Andrés, degi, Pedro, a-neggweburginmarmogadid.

Felipe, Natanael-aminaded. Amisgu, ega sogded: —Anmar dule-wargwen amisad. Igi Moisés e-Igar-Mesisadgi-narmaksagusa, degi, igi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad narmaksagusmarmoga, yoedse dule-wargwen danikoye, a-dule anmar amisad. A-dule, Jesúsʼye-nugad, Nazaretʼginedid, José-machid.
Natanael, abin-sogded: —¿Ar Nazaret-neggweburgi sunna ibmar-nued nodasi? Felipe, abin-sogded: —Be anba dage, adi, be-sunnad be dakoed.
Jesús, Natanael-ese-warmakdani-dakargu, Natanaelʼgi sogded: —Wedi, Israel-dule-sunnadid, dule-nuedid. We-dule, e-gwagegi emar-yardaked gwen naisulid.
Natanael Jesúsʼga sogded: —¿Wede igi be an-wisi an deyobid? Jesús, abin-sogded: —Amba yoo Felipe bese goleunni, deun sapi-higuera-urba amba be sigua, bato an be-daksad.
Natanael Jesúsʼga sogdesunnad: —Rabí, be Bab-Dummad-Machid, Israel-e-Rey-sunnadid. A-ular, be an-wisid.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Higuera-sapi-urba-sii an be-daksaye an bega sogsad-ulale, be an-bensuli? Weba bur bule ibmar-dummagan be dakoed.
Jesús sogdebar: —Napira an bemarga soged, emi-onodedgi bemar nibneg-argade, degi, Bab-Dummad-e-baliwiturmar Dule-Machigi nakwemai, degi, aidemai, be dakoed.
